name: Nigrescent-Cairn
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near subterranean ocean.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.

The terrain around starship crash site (colony ship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
